newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa consolidating into higher ground.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa consolidating into higher ground.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa is consolidating into a higher range after Tuesday's break upwards, analysts said.
Traders called cocoa to open six stg higher.
Trevor Neil, senior technical analyst at Union Cal Futures, said he did not expect the market to go much below 1,140 stg on benchmark September.
There was support between there and 1,100 stg, he said. "Once the overbought condition resolves itself, I would expect the high of 1,162 to be taken out."
But there was a risk if the market were to move lower. "If 1,100 were to be taken out, there'd be no support until 1,072," he said.
New York cocoa futures ended modestly higher in whiplash trading on Thursday, bolstered by a late-session round of local buying, dealers said.
LIFFE cocoa futures were tightly mixed by the close on Thursday in routine switch activity by locals and trade, with the market taking a breather after the recent rally.
"It is taking time off," said one trader.
